scope: Only third putty application and sanding on prepared plaster/precast mineral walls for high-quality painting, not complete wall levelling or all coats

krer.abrasive_unit: Literal m2 in scan; no inferred thousand multiplier or sheets conversion
krer.original_putty_resource: Oil-glue putty 0.029t/100m2 is replaced, not added as a second paid resource

ct127.selected_mix_method: Visible preliminary whole-bag batches; mixing water uses powder actually mixed, never new order or dry reserve. Wet surplus is separate and may only be reused within manufacturer storage conditions

ct17_optional.exact_locator: TDS No CT17 Profi 03.24, pages 1-2: painting scope, dilution and drying rules; page 2: 0.1-0.5 l/m2 range, conditions and 1/2/5/10 l packaging

additional_resources: Individually disclosed mixing/application/sanding tools, water, protection and waste bags are visible preliminary site planning inputs, not invented published norms
prior_preparation: Assumed already prepared and primed for this third-coat scope; optional new CT17 operation is explicit and has separate materials and project labour requirement
